title: Node attachment limits are guessed from IMDS — nodes with extra non-CSI volumes should pin --reserved-volume-attachments

detection.reason: whether a node mounts extra non-CSI EBS volumes is decided by its launch template, not the cluster

quote: It is strongly encouraged for users that need to reserve a well-known number of volume slots for non-CSI volumes (such as mounting an extra volume for `/var/lib/docker` data) use this new CLI option to avoid incorrect or incosistent behavior from the heuristic.
remediation: On node groups whose launch template attaches extra EBS volumes (a /var/lib/docker or containerd data disk), set --reserved-volume-attachments on the node plugin (EKS add-on: node.reservedVolumeAttachments) to the number of those volumes. Otherwise the plugin's IMDS guess can over-report the CSINode attach limit and pods get stuck attaching instead of being scheduled elsewhere.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds ebs-csi-node -o json | jq -r '.spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.name == "ebs-plugin") | .args | join(" ")'  # no --reserved-volume-attachments / --volume-attach-limit means the IMDS heuristic decides the limit
coversNotes: Add ability to override heuristic-determined reserved attachments via

title: Volumes created after the topology-key migration cannot be used by a driver older than v1.28

detection.reason: which volumes were created after the migration is not collected

quote: After this future migration, downgrades of the EBS CSI Driver to versions prior to `v1.28.0` will become impossible in some environments (particularly, environments not running the [AWS CCM](https://github.com/kubernetes/cloud-provider-aws)).
remediation: Treat v1.28 as the rollback floor once the driver is at v1.33 or newer: volumes it creates carry the topology.kubernetes.io/zone key, which drivers before v1.28 do not report, so those volumes cannot be scheduled or attached after a rollback below v1.28.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pv -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.csi.driver == "ebs.csi.aws.com") | "\(.metadata.name): \([.spec.nodeAffinity.required.nodeSelectorTerms[].matchExpressions[].key] | unique | join(","))"'  # PVs listing topology.kubernetes.io/zone need a driver at v1.28 or newer
coversNotes: A future release of the EBS CSI Driver will migrate the topology key for created volumes
